This run's exit 0 is a stronger assertion than build #1's identical exit 0, because the same checker gained two ERROR rules today; a green result that changed meaning without changing colour is exactly the case a re-test exists to catch.
The declared checker's description predicts its own output string verbatim, and the run reproduced it exactly, so a reader can tell a passing run from a vacuous one without opening the capture.

The committed worked example still carries build #1's layouts - the same content the mock deploy proved undeployable, and which the current checker rejects with four ERRORs - so the repo's canonical example is now behind the live build.

Half two of the manual test cannot be evaluated at this point in the build at all, because the validation step it depends on is still pending; it will only become tickable after M3-S01 produces ValidationRule metadata.
